purpose: First hardware session of firmware/robot-link: ESP32-P4 as the FPGA's host over header pins G7/G8 instead of the dock's USB UART
motor_supply_off_reported_by_operator: Operator confirmed the bench supply output off and the P4 unplugged before the load
fpga_image: bridge_safety (supervised bridge, SAFETY_ENABLE=1, RELEASE_TX=1) with host UART moved to G7 (host_rx) / G8 (host_tx)

rtl_sources.repo: ~/projects/sipeed-tang-primer-25k at 3733582 with uncommitted changes to servo/src/bridge.v; hashes below identify the files used

tests_before_load.firmware/robot-link: make -C cosim: PASS, finished just after the load and before the P4 was powered (boot, arm/hold/release 30 PWM writes 0 timeouts, session loss, host loss, stop button)

programming: SRAM only; openFPGALoader -b tangprimer25k, Load SRAM 100%, DONE
readback: Not possible over USB: this image takes its host link on G7/G8, not the FT2232. Supervisor status is read through the P4 once it is plugged in.

host.config: UART1 115200 baud, TX GPIO20 -> G7, RX GPIO21 <- G8, servos 0x1C0 (IDs 10-12), duty cap 100, AP robot-link on channel 6

event_before_load: Dock and P4 were both powered at once while the dock still ran its flash image. No constraints file in the Tang repo assigns G7 or G8, so the flash image leaves them as unused inputs; the P4 was unplugged before this load.
note: SRAM image: a dock power cycle reverts to its flash image. Reload this image (with a new receipt) before powering the P4.
